decisions.decision: Two-mode storage: local-only (no Firebase loaded) OR cloud (Firebase + Google login)
decisions.rationale: User wants to share app with colleagues who may not trust cloud storage. Privacy-by-design — local mode never imports Firebase SDK.

decisions.decision: Firebase web API key kept public in committed source
decisions.rationale: Firebase web API keys are public by design (https://firebase.google.com/docs/projects/api-keys). Real security is enforced by Firestore rules + authorized domains + API key HTTP-referrer restrictions in Google Cloud — all configured.

decisions.decision: Night defined as sunset+30min → sunrise-30min (civil twilight proxy)
decisions.rationale: Standard EASA/FAA aviation definition. Sun calculation uses NOAA-style algorithm inlined (~30 LOC), no external dependency. Verified vs published sunrise/sunset tables.

decisions.decision: Airport DB seeded with ~110 IATA codes for Ryanair STN ops; user can add custom entries in-app
decisions.rationale: Static list covers common destinations. User can extend without redeploy via the airports card. Each entry: IATA → {lat, lon} in degrees, +N/+E.

decisions.decision: Stable git tag stable-pre-night-detection at commit 90b3cc0
decisions.rationale: Last known fully-validated state before TO_NIGHT/LDG_NIGHT schema change. Revert command documented for emergency rollback.

next_action: Wait for user to test (a) night detection in a real exported CSV and (b) wizard acceptance of the new 37-col schema. If wizard breaks, revert to tag stable-pre-night-detection.
